SQL query
snippet:
SELECT u.id, u.name, COUNT(p.id) AS post_count
FROM users AS u
LEFT JOIN posts AS p ON p.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.active = TRUE AND u.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY u.id, u.name
ORDER BY post_count DESC;
